parsed_payload.reasoning: Let A=n, B=β, C=γ. Since O and X are inside the acute triangle, they are on the same side of BC, so in cyclic quadrilateral B,O,X,C, ∠BOC=∠BXC. Also ∠BOC=2n. In triangle BXC, ∠XBC=β/2. Since CX is perpendicular to AB and CB makes angle β with AB, ∠BCX=90°−β. Thus ∠BXC=180°−(β/2)−(90°−β)=90°+β/2. Hence 2n=90°+β/2, so β=4n−180. Then γ=180°−n−β=360°−5n. The acute conditions give β<90° ⇒ n<67.5°, γ<90° ⇒ n>54°, and γ>0 ⇒ n<72°. Therefore 54°<n<67.5°, and the largest integer n is 67.
